leadText:
Blue Moon Falls (Japanese: 青い満月の滝 Blue Fullmoon Falls) is an -exclusive location in Johto. It is located close to Cherrygrove City.

While and were resting near Cherrygrove City, the GS Ball they were carrying was taken by a . The local Officer Jenny explained that all the Pokémon was doing was taking it to Blue Moon Falls for an annual celebration. Ash, both intrigued and eager to get the Ball back, decided to investigate this further. Later, he and his friends stumbled across Blue Moon Falls. They witnessed hundreds of Quagsire with round-shaped objects. At midnight, they tossed the objects into the air and used to send them over the falls. The following morning, all the objects, including the GS Ball, floated safely back down stream.
